- The page must type-check under strict TypeScript, pass `next build`, and render without console errors.
- Make it responsive from phone to desktop, and accessible.

# Once UI — compact codegen rules Load with task bundle from `@once-ui-system/core/ai/tasks/{intent}.json`. For an app shell, a sidebar nav or an editor, read `ai/layouts.md` first — those are the shapes that are hard to get right from props alone. For production-quality composition, read matching Pro blocks from `examples/blocks/manifest.json`. Fetch component slices on demand. ## Layout | Write | Never write | |-------|-------------| | `` | `` | | `` | ``, or `` with no direction | | `fill` | `fillWidth fillHeight` | | `fit` | `fitWidth fitHeight` | | `center` | `horizontal="center" vertical="center"` | | `maxWidth="l"` | `fillWidth maxWidth="l"` | | `fillWidth` | `fillWidth minWidth={0}` | | `border` | `border="neutral-alpha-weak"` | | `` | a `` and a `` | - `Flex` only when direction changes at breakpoints: `` - Subtree theme: `theme`, `themeBorder`, `themeSolid`, `themeSurface` on Flex/Row/Column/Grid and components built on them (`Background`, `Tag`, effects) — not raw `data-theme`/`data-border`/`data-solid`. `Button`/`IconButton` have no typed prop: keep `data-border="rounded"` - Page skeleton: `Column as="main" fillWidth horizontal="center"` → content `Column maxWidth="l"` → sections - Section gaps: `"104"` between sections, `"24"`–`"40"` inside. Never `"48"` between major sections. - Responsive: breakpoint props `xl l m s xs` — never media queries for layout ## Surfaces Static panel recipe (pricing tiers, stats, settings sections): ```tsx ``` - Bare `border` (and `borderTop`, `borderBottom`, …) = the default border. Name a colour only to deviate: `border="brand-alpha-medium"`. - `Card` = interactive only (`href` or `onClick`). Static panels = Column + surface recipe. - Colors: `{scheme}-{weight}` or `{scheme}-alpha-{weight}`. Never hex/rgb — inline SVG `fill`/`stroke` included: `currentColor` or `var(--brand-solid-strong)`. - `background` also: `surface | overlay | page | transparent` ## Typography - Hero: `display-strong-l` or `display-strong-xl` - Section titles: `display-strong-xs` or `display-strong-s` — not `heading-*` - Eyebrow: `` - Text on layout: `textVariant` + `onBackground` on Row/Column instead of nesting Text ## Decoration Absolute layers always: `position="absolute" top="0" left="0" fill pointerEvents="none"`, content `zIndex={1}`. - `zIndex` only inside that layer group (or on a sticky header over its pane). Never on a lone element, never a page-wide ladder. - Gradient `width`: quarter-percent (400 = 100%). Glows: 100–200. - Glow colors: `brand-alpha-medium`, not `brand-background-weak` - Ambient layers on full-bleed section wrapper, outside `maxWidth` column - Budget: one ambient layer per section; motion in hero + one CTA max ## Motion - `RevealFx delay` (and `ShineFx`/`CountFx`/`TypeFx speed`) in **milliseconds**: `delay={index * 100}` — `* 0.1` was 1.8.x. `speed` on `MatrixFx`, `WeatherFx`, `ParticleFx` is a multiplier - `RevealFx translateY`: number = rem; prefer `"8"`–`"16"` tokens - Viewport-reveal with `useInViewport` + latch into `RevealFx revealed`; `CountFx` driven by `value`, no trigger prop - Animate all siblings in a set or none — never one lone animated card ## Components | Need | Use | |------|-----| | Image | `Media` | | Link | `SmartLink` / `Button href` | | Status dot | `StatusIndicator` | | Loading | `Spinner` / `Skeleton` | | Scroll fade | `Fade` as edge strip, not wrapper | | Icons | `IconName` from spec only | | Logos grid | `LogoCloud` with `columns` set | | Tabs | `Tabs` > `TabList` > `Tab`, `TabPanel` (`orientation="vertical"` for a settings nav) | | Mobile nav, side sheet | `Drawer`, not a hand-made overlay | | Page trail | `Breadcrumbs items={[...]}` | | Keyboard shortcut | `useHotkeys("mod+k", fn)` + `KeyTip keys="mod+k"` | | Screen-reader text, skip link | `VisuallyHidden` | | MDX content | `mdxComponents` / `createMdxComponents` from `/mdx` | ## Imports Most things come from the package root. These do not — the manifest's `imports` lists every entry point with its exports, and each slice, catalog entry and `spec.json` `functions` entry says `importFrom` when it is not the root: | Import | From | |--------|------| | charts, gauges, chart chrome | `@once-ui-system/core/data` (needs `recharts`) | | `CodeBlock` | `@once-ui-system/core/code` (needs `prismjs`) | | `MediaUpload` | `@once-ui-system/core/media` (needs `compressorjs`) | | `mdxComponents`, `createMdxComponents`, `Mdx*` elements | `@once-ui-system/core/mdx` (needs `prismjs`) | | `MediaAudioPlayer`, `MediaVideoPlayer` | `@once-ui-system/core/components/` | | `LayoutProvider` in a **Next.js** app; `createOgFetchRoute`, `createOgProxyRoute` | `@once-ui-system/core/next` | | `defineConfig`, `OnceUIConfig` in `once-ui.config` | `@once-ui-system/core/config` (also on the root) | Naming one of these from the root does not resolve — except `defineConfig`, which is on both, and `LayoutProvider`, which resolves and then silently renders links and images as plain `` and `` in a Next.js app. `IconName` is a real union, so an unregistered icon name is a type error, not a blank space — take names from `iconNames` in `catalog.json`. ## Defaults — omit these `position="relative"`, `direction` on Row/Column, `variant="primary"` on Button, `size="m"` when default, `fillWidth` beside `maxWidth`, `minWidth={0}` beside `fillWidth`, a border colour that restates the default. ## Before building If design intent unclear, ask: content style, layout width, color approach, decoration level, imagery. Default: restrained, centered `maxWidth="m"`, single brand accent, one subtle gradient, no placeholder images.

The output shows the server starting fine, so the failure is probably a runtime render error. I can't see it, so I'll look for likely culprits and remove them.

Suspects:
-   `width={2.5}` / `height={2.5}`: numeric sizes may be treated as tokens or rem, and `width={4}` likewise.
-   `aria-*` props passed to Once UI `Text`/`Column`, which may not forward them.
-   `Text as="h3"` with `style`.
-   `s={{ paddingLeft: "0" }}`, and `href="#"` on `Button` going through the Next link adapter.
-   `CelebrationFx` with `position`/`fill` props.

I'll switch to safer constructs: native elements with inline styles for the fixed-size circle, plain `Button onClick` instead of `href="#"`, native `ol`/`li`/`h3` wrappers for semantics, and `CelebrationFx` inside a plain absolute wrapper.
